CustomObject.description: One record per user whose dashboard visibility should be scoped to specific Country__c value(s) instead of role-hierarchy-based scoping. Name = Username (exact match). Countries__c = comma-separated Country__c values, replacing their normal hierarchy/share visibility. List Custom Setting (not CMDT) so rows can be created directly in production (Setup -> Custom Settings -> Manage), no metadata record deploy needed.
CustomObject.label: Dashboard Country Override
